displayName: Lumen AI Gateway - Enterprise Security Alert Suite

conditions.displayName: Spike in Model Armor Security Prompt Blocks
High Rate of Egress Sensitive Data Redactions

documentation.content:
### Lumen Gateway Security Incident Response

This policy triggers when security events breach the rate threshold over a 5-minute window (> 2 events at 0.006/s).

**Triage Queries in Cloud Logging:**
- **Authorization Denials:**
  ```text
  resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
  jsonPayload.event_type="SECURITY_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED"
  ```
- **Model Armor Prompt Blocks:**
  ```text
  resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
  jsonPayload.event_type="SECURITY_PROMPT_BLOCKED"
  ```
- **Egress PII Redactions:**
  ```text
  resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
  jsonPayload.event_type="SECURITY_PII_REDACTED"
  ```
